metadata.othernotes:
Edelgard is intended to have costumes depicting her in three different time periods across at least two timelines. The time periods and the costumes associated with them are as follows.

Academy Phase (Academy Uniform): Depicts an 18 year old Edelgard during late Part I of Fire Emblem: Three Houses (sometime between 12/16 and 2/22 on the in-game calendar). Strongly implies a timeline where Byleth teaches the Black Eagles, but not to the point that other FE3H characters would be compelled to contradict her if they came from a different timeline.

War Phase (War Outfit): Depicts an 23 year old Edelgard during Part II of Fire Emblem: Three Houses. Explicitly from the Crimson Flower route, sometime after Chapter 14, with all of the Golden Deer surviving.

Three Hopes (Hopes Outfit *still in planning*]): Depicts a 20 year-old Edelgard sometime during Part II of Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes. Either explicity from the Scarlet Blaze route, or route agnostic between Scarlet Blaze and Golden Wildfire.

Both the War Phase and Three Hopes versions of Edelgard have ascended the throne are no longer students.

Although Edelgard clarifies that formalities aren't necessary after her first strip, if you want your character to address her formally, or otherwise discuss her status, you should note that the proper title and style differ between the Academy and War/Hopes versions of the character.

In the Academy Phase Edelgard is properly: Her Highness, Princess Edelgard.

The War Phase/Hopes versions are properly: Her Majesty, Emperor Edelgard. (Note, that is "EMPEROR", she is never refered to as "empress" in canon, and if your character does so I will assume you want her to correct them).

"Lady Edelgard" is proper adress for any version.

When Edelgard is selected or changes costumes she will set a marker: "AcademyPhase", "WarPhase", or "ThreeHopes". For the sake of simplicity and future-proofing it's recommended to use these instead of costume checks for lines that should apply to every costume from a given time-period.

case.name: Chess, Anyone?
case.description: Edelgard enjoys chess and wants to know if any of the other (non-FE3H) characters at the table plays.

case.name: Tea or Coffee?
case.description: Edelgard wants to know whether the others prefer tea or coffee.

case.name: Lingua Franca
case.description: Edelgard mentions how strange it is that players from different worlds can understand each other.

case.name: Governance
case.description: Edelgard wants to know about interesting forms of government in other players' worlds.

case.name: Worlds Without Crests
case.description: Edelgard mentions Crests, a concept likely unfamiliar to other players. She will explain in the next phase.

case.name: Crestology 101
case.description: Edelgard gives a brief overview of Crests and their role in Fódlan's society.

case.name: Crest Problems
case.description: Edelgard talks about some of the problems that arise in Fódlan because of Crests. (First hand after situation "Crestology 101")

case.name: No Need For Formalities
case.description: Edelgard assures the table that there is no need to treat her differently on account of being a princess.

case.name: Under Surveillance
case.description: Edelgard mentions that Hubert's spies may be watching the game.

case.name: Sketchbook
case.description: Edelgard lost a sketchbook and would like it returned, but is admant that nobody should look inside it.

case.name: Destiny
case.description: Edelgard wonders whether the others believe a person can choose their own destiny.

case.name: Heresies
case.description: *Academy Phase Only* Edelgard mentions that she could be branded a heretic for coming to the Inventory.

case.name: Solitude
case.description: Edelgard wonders if others ever wish they could be be completely alone.

case.name: A Better Angle
case.description: Edelgard turns around to present an angle which obscures her scars.

case.name: Self Awareness
case.description: *Academy Uniform Only (subject to change)* Edelgard is resigned to being seen as distant and arrogant. (Immediately precedes the situation "Lone Eagle")

case.name: Lone Eagle
case.description: *Academy Uniform Only (subject to change)* Edelgard opens up a bit about how lonely her life can be. (Immediately follows the situation "Self Awareness")

case.name: Revealing Scars
case.description: Edelgard gives a warning as she prepares to reveal her scars. *This case covers her Academy Uniform only, for other costumes look under their respective folders.*

case.name: Scars Revealed
case.description: Edelgard has revealed the scars on her torso. *This case covers her Academy Uniform only, for other costumes look under their respective folders.* (Immediately follows situation "Revealing Scars")

case.name: Hot for Teacher
case.description: *Not Three Hopes* Edelgard screamed "my teacher" when she climaxed.

case.name: Special Weapons
case.description: Edelgard asks a character stripping their weapon about if their world has any "sacred" or "holy" weapons. (Immediately precedes the situation "Heroes' Relics")

case.name: Heroes' Relics
case.description: Edelgard follows her question about special weapons by discussing Fódlan's Heroes's Relics, including the fact that they can turn people without Crests into monsters. (Immediately precedes the situation "Special Weapons")

case.name: Good Books
case.description: Edelgard asks the table about any interesting books they've read.

case.name: Impressions
case.description: *Academy Uniform Only (subject to change)* Edelgard does a goofy impression of another FE3H character, contrasting her previously serious demeanor. (This case only exists for the callout, see the "Impressions" folder for the actual cases)

case.name: Mother Hen
case.description: Edelgard complains of a friend comparing her to an overbearing mother.

case.name: Marvelous Diversity
case.description: Edelgard marvels at how such a diverse group of people gather at the Inventory.

case.name: Rivals
case.description: Edelgard asks the table about people who consider them rivals.

case.name: Enbarr
case.description: Edelgard offers to give the table a tour of the Imperial capital, if she has time.

case.name: Cheater Beater
case.description: Edelgard admonishes a character with the "Cheater (Cards)" tag for thinking they could best her through underhanded means.

case.name: Fake Crown
case.description: *Not Academy Phase* When Edelgard strips her crown in the pesence of potential thieves she will mention that it's a replica of no real worth. *This case covers her War Outfit only, for other costumes look under their respective folders.*

case.name: Letting Her Hair Down
case.description: *War Phase Only* After removing her War Phase crown, Edelgard's buns come undone, revealing that she still has long hair. *This case covers her War Outfit only, for other costumes look under their respective folders.*

case.name: Fake Boobs
case.description: *War Outfit Only (subject to change)* Edelgard's armor made her boobs look bigger. She is very embarassed about being called on this, implying she was intentionally making herself bigger.

case.name: No Bullying Bernie
case.description: Edelgard makes clear that anybody who tries to pick on Bernadetta will have to deal with her.

case.name: Desired Gifts
case.description: *Snowfall Future Only* Edelgard asks what kind of gifts the others would like for the winter festival (Christmas).

case.name: A Gift for Edelgard
case.description: *Snowfall Future Only* If she doesn't have anything to say about somebody else's desired gift, Edelgard mentions that she would like a new quill pen.
